name: Demo Filer
narrative: First job out of college, CTC ~9.5 LPA at a single employer for the full year. Has a small Zerodha demat account with dividend income of Rs 1,040 from 3 stocks and Rs 2,300 savings bank interest. No home loan. Contributes to EPF (80C). Hero persona for the ITR-1 flow; new tax regime works out better.
